title: TOEIC Listening & Reading Full Test 04
description: Đề thi đầy đủ theo cấu trúc đề TOEIC Listening & Reading của IIG Việt Nam: 200 câu, 120 phút (Listening ~45 phút audio chạy liên tục, Reading 75 phút). Chủ đề: mua sắm thiết bị, du lịch, triển lãm nghệ thuật, nhà máy, ngân hàng số, vườn cộng đồng, giao thông công cộng; đủ dạng hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý, biểu đồ, chèn câu, đoạn kép và ba đoạn. Mỗi câu có giải thích tiếng Việt.

groups.transcript:
W: Hello, I'm calling about my Internet service. It's been extremely slow for the past three days, and I work from home.
M: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me run a test on your line. Hmm, it looks like there's a problem with the connection outside your building. I can send a technician on Friday afternoon.
W: I have an important video conference on Thursday.
M: I understand. Let me see what I can do. OK, I've moved your appointment to Wednesday morning between nine and eleven.
W: Thank you. And will I be charged for the visit?
M: No, since the problem is on our side, there's no charge. We'll also credit your account for the days the service was slow.

questions.content: What is the woman calling about?
questions.explanation: 'It's been extremely slow for the past three days' → Internet chậm.

questions.content: Why does the woman say, "I have an important video conference on Thursday"?

options.A: To ask for a faster service plan
options.B: To indicate that Friday is too late
options.C: To explain why she is working from home

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: thợ đến chiều thứ Sáu nhưng cô cần mạng tốt cho cuộc họp thứ Năm → thứ Sáu là quá muộn; nhân viên liền dời lịch sang sáng thứ Tư.

questions.content: What does the man say the company will do?

options.C: Give her a credit on her account

questions.explanation: 'We'll also credit your account for the days the service was slow.'
